Colors used by the bar chart race

Source: R/theme.R
race_palette.Rd

A qualitative palette of muted teals, greens, blues, purples and warm earth tones, chosen to stay readable side by side in a dense stack of bars.

Usage

race_palette(n = 26)

Arguments

n

Number of colors to return. The palette is recycled when n is larger than the number of base colors.

Value

A character vector of n hex colors.

Examples

race_palette(5)
#> [1] "#22928F" "#B66399" "#BF6662" "#757CC6" "#4BAAA9"
